Ameslaw yettwasesfer s tewsa-a send ayen i tesleḍ. Tazdeg tameqqrant tɛeddi akuden anda tiliɣri tefka i usnas akud drus (agdil yensa, tiliɣri teččur) war tigzam, maca ibeddilen n yimesli (amseddi, crossfeed, imaɣnuten) ad ttwaslen s wakud-a ɣer deffir. Awurman yebda s 2 s yerna tasint deffir yal tagzemt, armi d 5 s. Tanzagt tamaynut tettwasnes deffir uɛeddi, anadi neɣ aseḥbes i d-iteddun.

Deg urar, aɣerbaz yettraǧu alamma tazdeg tesra ameslaw nniḍen deg wadeg n usenqed yal 10 ms. Yesseḥraz akud n usesfar d tbatrit s ugdil yensan, yeggaret tigzam s yisemdan iɣeblen, war ma yesra tazdeg tameqqrant. Ad yettwasnes tikkelt i d-iteddun ara yeldi uɣerbaz.
Ala mi ara yettwaurar uẓawan; deg usteɛfu agdil yettensi am wakken iwulem.
Yettwasbadu yal tikkelt ameslaw iteddu ɣer tuffɣa-a; tzemreḍ ad t-tbeddleḍ deg usmeẓẓi.

Aɣerbaz n uẓawan i yifuyla idiganen d tebdarin, s usesfer-is n yimesli: war tilmawin, asefsi amyeddi, ReplayGain, agzam n tsusmi, amseddi, crossfeed, asaḥaṣ d umḥaddi.

Asedduy yettserwas amek tfukk yal tizlit d wamek bdant tiyiḍ. Ala tisinin timezwura d tineggura n yal afaylu i yettwafesren, yiwet n tikkelt; ifuyla yettwabeddlen ttwasleḍen tikkelt nniḍen. Iteddu s tazwart tadrust, ihi tzemreḍ ad tkemmleḍ aseqdec n usnas d usmeẓẓi. War tasleḍt deg ugilal, tizlatin n tebdart ttwasleḍent mi ara tt-tesseddumeḍ.

Seddu tabdart (deg wumuɣ n tebdart tamirant) tebda s tezlit itteddun, tḍeffer yal tikkelt s tin i d-yeqqimen ideg tazwara tecba ugar taggara n tin yezrin — tikli, aṭimbr, armud, tasarut d tezlit — sakin tesmuttiy tizlatin akken ula d yiwen n uɛeddi ur yeqqim yugar wiyaḍ s wudem dir.
Acḥal seg taggara n tezlit i yettwaserwasen d tazwara n tin i d-iteddun. Abeddel-is yebɣa ad d-yini tasleḍt n tezlatin akk tikkelt nniḍen.
